content: vimspector requires Vim 8.2.4797+ HUGE build with python3.10+ -> must use vim-full-based flavors (plain vim lacks python3). Confirmed packaged as vimPlugins.vimspector in nixpkgs (vim-plugin-names contains puremourning/vimspector). Default install path downloads gadgets (:VimspectorInstall / g:vimspector_install_gadgets) - avoid for no-runtime-fetch; instead define adapters via user-supplied .gadgets.d/*.json files inside plugin gadgets/<os>/ dir, or g:vimspector_adapters dict in vimrc. C++ adapters in nix: lldb-vscode from pkgs.lldb (lib.getExe pkg.lldb lldb-vscode, needs llvm-symbolizer in PATH), or CodeLLDB at ${pkgs.vscode-extensions.vadimcn.vscode-lldb}/share/vscode/extensions/vadimcn.vscode-lldb/adapter/codelldb (self-contained, recommended for C++). Python: debugpy adapter - custom command [debugpy, --listen, 5678] with pkgs.python3Packages.debugpy.
